He holds an MS in Human Nutrition and an MSPAS from Lenoir-Rhyne University. A Fellow in Anti-Aging, Metabolic and Functional Medicine and Diplomate of the American Board of Anti-Aging Health Practitioners, Renaud specializes in hormone imbalance, metabolic syndrome, Lyme disease, autoimmune conditions, and regenerative medicine. Services by Colin Renaud Men's Health Med Matrix in South Portland, Maine treats men's health conditions including low testosterone, brain fog, fatigue, and muscle loss. We test total and free testosterone, estradiol, DHEA-S, cortisol, thyroid, fasting insulin, and inflammatory markers. Your protocol is built on 80+ biomarkers, not a single lab value. Learn more → Erectile Dysfunction (ED) Treatment ED isn't just about blood flow. It's often the first sign that something deeper is off. Low testosterone, high estrogen, insulin resistance, cardiovascular dysfunction, or stress hormones. We test for all of it and treat the root cause, not just the symptom. Learn more → Lyme Disease Treatment You got a tick bite. You were treated for Lyme. The antibiotics are done. But you still feel terrible. Fatigue, joint pain, brain fog, neurological symptoms. Standard testing misses chronic Lyme and co-infections. We use advanced diagnostics to find what's still driving your symptoms. Learn more → Peptide Therapy Med Matrix in South Portland, Maine offers peptide therapy including BPC-157, sermorelin, CJC-1295/Ipamorelin, Thymosin Alpha-1, and AOD-9604. All peptides are sourced from licensed 503A/503B compounding pharmacies and prescribed after 80+ biomarker lab testing. Every protocol includes follow-up monitoring.
